name: comfyui-mcp
tagline_zh: 别在节点间迷路了。用自然语言指挥 ComfyUI 生成图、视频、音频，改工作流，连离线 Ollama 都能用。
tagline_en: Stop wrestling nodes. Command ComfyUI in plain English—images, video, audio, live graph edits, even on offline.
desc_en: Local-first, agent-native control plane for ComfyUI — MCP server + sidebar agent that generates images, video & audio, authors and runs workflows, and edits your live graph in natural language on ANY LLM (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, offline Ollama, or any hosted model). 178 tools, 36 AI skills, 55 installer packs. Local, LAN, VPS, or Comfy Cloud.
why_zh: 同类里唯一能直接改你正在跑的工作流，且不挑模型——本地、云端、离线都行，不是套壳，是真控制。
why_en: The only one that edits your live graph mid-run and works with any model—local, cloud, or offline. Real control, not a wrapper.
